query:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, pr.id as payment_id, pr.paymentPeriod, pr.amount, pr.paymentDate, pr.receiptTransferDate, pr.status, pr.createdAt
FROM students s 
LEFT JOIN payment_records pr ON s.id = pr.studentId 
WHERE s.name = '黃睿浠'
ORDER BY pr.paymentDate DESC;
